_why: Written 2026-08-08. StoryVault DOES ship Sign in with Apple and Google, so the site's wording is 'no account NEEDED' rather than 'no account'. That distinction is the whole approval — evidence below records what sign-in actually unlocks so nobody shortens the sentence. Verified against /Users/dee/Developer/DrVanus/storyvault-ios.

evidence: Reading and playing are accountless. The site says 'No account needed' (index.html trust row) and 'no account needed to read or play' (support.html) — both scoped to reading/playing, not to the whole product.

SIGN-IN EXISTS and gates only social surfaces: storyvault-ios/.../AuthStore.swift:13 records that 'liking + reporting check isSignedIn', MarketplaceTabView.swift:360,493 guard on auth.isSignedIn, and ProfileView.swift:33 renders the signed-out user as 'Guest'. Nothing in the reading or adventure path checks it.

Pro is StoreKit-only and works without an account: entitlement is derived from isPremiumUser, not from a session (SITE-CONTRADICTIONS-RESOLVED-2026-08-08.md §2). Build 3 was cut specifically to fix accountless Pro.

No analytics, attribution or ad SDK is linked: a grep of storyvault-ios/StoryVaultAI/StoryVaultAI.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj for GoogleMobileAds, AdMob, PostHog, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Crashlytics and FirebaseAnalytics returns nothing.
Crash handling is first-party and SDK-free: StoryVaultAI/CrashReporter.swift:29 records that adding Sentry or Crashlytics would mean swapping MetricKitSubscriber — i.e. neither is present today.

CAVEAT for the backend, not this site: if SENTRY_DSN is ever set on storyvault-api, the default LoggingIntegration would ship stack-frame locals (including story text) on ERROR. Re-check this approval if that happens.
No advertising SDK is linked into the app (same project.pbxproj grep as no_tracking), and there is no ad placement, rewarded flow, or ad-gated content anywhere in the reading or adventure path.
Monetisation is StoryVault Pro through StoreKit only.
